scripts.name: Setup worktree (restore frontend)
scripts.command: cd "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT}" && if [ -f frontendnet/frontendnet.csproj ]; then dotnet restore frontendnet/frontendnet.csproj; else echo 'frontendnet not scaffolded yet (F001)'; fi

scripts.name: Frontend: build gate
scripts.command: cd "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT}" && dotnet build frontendnet/frontendnet.csproj -c Release && ! grep -rn 'async void' frontendnet --include=*.cs

scripts.name: Backend: tests (audit evidence)
scripts.command: cd "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT}/backendnode" && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run
